##: The link published on the site (.../win-artifacts/Dumate-win-setup-x64-latest.exe) is a moving alias; this manifest uses the versioned copy from the electron-updater feed (.../artifacts-update/DuMate-Setup-<version>-x64.exe). Both are the same object (identical size and BOS CRC32/CRC32C/CRC64), but only the versioned path keeps a recorded hash valid.
Version is read from that feed's latest.yml. It publishes sha512 only, so autoupdate.hash is omitted and the 744 MiB installer is re-downloaded on update to compute the SHA-256.
The NSIS installer embeds the app as $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z; the installer script expands it into $dir, which produces the flat Electron layout with DuMate.exe at the root.
The bundled electron-updater stays enabled and points at the same feed, so the app may update itself outside Scoop.
description: AI assistant that automates cross-app and cross-file office tasks (Baidu DuMate)
notes: The installer stubs ($PLUGINSDIR, $R0 uninstaller) are dropped, so Scoop owns the uninstall.
User data is written outside the app directory, so nothing needs to be persisted.
Run 'scoop install dumate -f' to return to the packaged version after an in-app update.
